title: Inkloom AI SaaS Pricing Tiers & Subscription Matrix
citation: Golden Facts: Pricing Matrix v2.4 (Effective 2026), Section 1
content: Official Subscription Pricing Tiers for 2026: 1. Free Community Edition: $0/month, supports up to 3 editors, deterministic OpenCV color checks, and community forum support. 2. Professional Starter Tier: $49/month billed monthly, or $39/month billed annually. Includes up to 15 editors, real-time Chrome Extension CMS integration, full RAG Golden Facts validation, and 500 audit calls/day. (CRITICAL DEPRECATION NOTICE: The legacy $29/mo tier was discontinued in Q3 2024. Any reference to $29/month or $29 starter tier is strictly outdated and non-compliant). 3. Enterprise Tier: Custom pricing starting at $499/month, includes unlimited editors, SOC2 Type II compliance, VPC isolation, dedicated SLA (99.95%), custom brand swatch embeddings, and priority engineering support. Non-existent pricing plans like $19/mo, $25/mo, or $29/mo are obsolete.

key_rules.issue: Outdated pricing claim. Starter tier was updated from legacy $29/mo to $49/mo in Q3 2024.
Non-existent pricing plan cited. Community edition is Free ($0), Starter is $49/mo.
key_rules.rewrite: free Community tier or $49/mo Starter tier

key_rules.issue: Non-existent pricing plan cited. Official Starter tier is $49/month ($39/mo billed annually).

title: Banned Terminology, Risk Policy & Superlatives
citation: Brand Style Guide: Banned Terminology & Risk Policy 2026, Section 3
content: Inkloom AI brand voice is authoritative, transparent, explainable, and grounded in engineering rigor. We strictly prohibit deceptive AI hype and unprovable absolutes: 1. 'magic AI' or 'black-box magic': Banned. Replace with 'high-confidence AI assistance' or 'deterministic and explainable governance'. 2. 'cheapest': Disallowed superlative. Replace with 'most cost-effective enterprise solution'. 3. 'flawless': Disallowed absolute. Replace with 'rigorous and consistent' or 'enterprise-grade accuracy'. 4. '100% bug free' or '100% compliant guarantee': Strictly banned compliance liability. Replace with 'extensively tested and highly reliable' or 'statistically validated brand alignment'. 5. 'zero risk guaranteed': Banned claim. Replace with 'comprehensive risk mitigation'. 6. 'replaces all human reviewers': Inaccurate. Inkloom is designed as human-in-the-loop co-pilot, not autonomous replacement.

key_rules.issue: Banned term 'magic AI'. Inkloom relies on deterministic OpenCV rules and explainable LLMs, not black-box magic.
Disallowed superlative 'cheapest'. Violates enterprise brand voice standards.
Disallowed claim 'flawless'. Avoid absolute quality guarantees.
Disallowed compliance guarantee '100% bug free'. Legal risk for unprovable absolutes.
Disallowed absolute 'zero risk guaranteed'. Violates brand governance legal policy.
Misleading positioning. Inkloom empowers creators and accelerates reviews; it does not eliminate human review.

title: Official Brand Taglines, Slogans & Value Propositions
citation: Brand Style Guide: Official Taglines v2.4, Section 2
content: Official Approved Slogans & Taglines for Inkloom AI: 1. Primary Corporate Slogan: 'Velocity with Precision'. (CRITICAL: Do NOT alter to 'Velocity without precision', 'Speed over accuracy', or 'Velocity without control'). 2. Secondary Tagline: 'Explainable Brand Governance for Modern Creators'. 3. Value Proposition: 'Audit text claims and visual assets in real time right inside your CMS.' 4. Boilerplate Description: 'Inkloom AI is the hybrid brand governance platform that combines deterministic OpenCV pixel extraction with RAG-grounded LLM verification to eliminate brand drift across distributed teams.'

key_rules.issue: Distorted brand slogan. Approved corporate tagline is 'Velocity with Precision'.
Contradicts core brand value proposition. We champion precision alongside velocity.

title: Data Privacy, Security Architecture & Customer Data Protection
citation: Security & Trust Whitepaper: Data Protection Architecture 2026, Section 4
content: Security, Compliance & Data Privacy Architecture: 1. Zero Model Training Policy: Inkloom AI strictly enforces zero LLM model training or fine-tuning on customer DOM content, draft copy, or uploaded assets. 2. Ephemeral Processing: Draft text and image assets inspected by the Chrome Extension or API are evaluated transiently in-memory and immediately discarded unless explicitly escalated to the human review queue. 3. Infrastructure: All API microservices are hosted on enterprise Google Cloud Platform (GCP) with TLS 1.3 in-transit and AES-256 at-rest encryption. 4. Certifications: Enterprise Tier supports SOC2 Type II compliance, VPC peering, and custom data processing agreements (DPA). Any claim stating customer content is saved for public training or stored insecurely is false.

key_rules.issue: Incorrect security claim. Inkloom AI enforces zero model-training and transient data handling.
key_rules.rewrite: processes content transiently with a strict zero-model-training guarantee

title: Platform Capabilities, Split Vision Engine & CMS Integrations
citation: Product Architecture Spec: Split Vision Engine v2.0, Section 5
content: Core Platform Architecture & Specifications: 1. Split Vision Engine: Combines deterministic OpenCV pixel matrix sampling (K-means k=3, Delta E Euclidean color distance against approved brand palette) executing in <5ms with zero LLM hallucination, paired with Gemini Vision for qualitative tone and vibe checks. 2. Brand Palette Standards: Primary Inkloom Indigo (#4F46E5), Secondary Cyan (#06B6D4), Neutral Dark Slate (#0F172A). Maximum acceptable color tolerance Delta E is 38.0. 3. In-Context Chrome Extension: Manifest V3 extension operating across rich CMS editors including WordPress (Gutenberg), Webflow, Medium, Canva, and LinkedIn. Injects inline visual highlight badges and provides 1-click in-place prescriptive rewrites. 4. Review Escalation Queue: Allows creators to escalate borderline flags directly to brand managers via the unified dashboard.
